races.langs: Common, Elvish, Two languages of your choice

feats.d: You have an advantage on saving throws against spells or effects that Charm you.

subs.desc: You are a High elf whose lineage traces back to the western country of Astoria.

feats.d: Choose a 1st level spell of your choice from the Wizard spell list, you know that spell and may cast it once per day.
